featured_reviews.name: Raghav Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a busy lawyer based in Toronto, my vacations are usually packed with family and city hopping. This time, while visiting Delhi and Mumbai, my sister—who’s lived in Mumbai for four years—gently pushed me far outside my comfort zone.
She had found deep transformation through yoga at Sacred Space Yoga, and I could see it in her calm, clarity and energy.

When she suggested the Shiv Yatra retreat led by Acharya Shiv and Harsh Pandey Sir, I hesitated—recent weight gain and zero flexibility made it intimidating. But I trusted her. And what followed was nothing short of magical.

From the first step into the Prabhadevi centre, a wave of peace washed over me. Among 15 strangers, there was instant connection—no judgment, just shared intent. Harsh Sir’s warmth and reverence for his brother set the tone, and when Shiv Sir entered, everything aligned: strength, grounding, humility, and authenticity. They truly walk the talk.

Over 24 hours, I experienced things I never had before—sattvik meals eaten in mindful silence, real meditation where the mind finally slowed, teachings that beautifully connected yoga to our cultural roots, and deep conversations with strangers who felt like family. A walk through Lions Park, herbal tea that somehow tasted divine, sleeping in a tent (never thought I would), and yoga that wasn’t about perfection—but about showing up honestly. That realisation alone changed something fundamental in me.
The sound healing session was especially profound—vibrations that shook loose buried emotions and old traumas, allowing release, lightness, and renewal.

What elevated everything was the genuine care—from the Pandey family, the way Shiv Sir and Harsh Sir ensured everyone’s comfort and safe return, and how they made us feel truly looked after. It wasn’t a retreat; it was family.

Shiv Yatra wasn’t just an experience—it was a divine wake-up call. I arrived skeptical and left transformed. Five stars aren’t enough. Infinite gratitude. Highly recommended for anyone seeking peace, regardless of age, body, or background.

featured_reviews.name: Aanchal Mittal
featured_reviews.review_text:

This is not like a regular yoga class; it’s a complete experience, something you would usually plan and pay for on a weekend retreat.

featured_reviews.name: Anusha Tiwari
featured_reviews.review_text:
What unfolded over those precious hours was far beyond a retreat, it was a profound inner awakening. From the very first step into Sacred Space Yoga, there was a sense of calm, safety, and belonging that’s hard to put into words. Shiv Sir and Harsh Sir don’t merely teach yoga; they embody it with rare authenticity, humility, and grace.

Their presence, guidance, and values created an environment where transformation felt natural and deeply personal.

One of the most touching aspects for me was the sense of family they cultivated through their warmth, care, and attention to every single participant. Whether it was the mindful sattvik meals, the soulful meditations, the sound healing session, or the simple yet powerful conversations, everything felt intentional and deeply rooted in spirituality and awareness.

The kirtan session deserves special mention, it was pure magic. The collective chanting, rhythm, and devotion dissolved all barriers of mind. In that moment, there was only sound, surrender, and a deep connection to something far greater than ourselves. It left the heart full and the soul vibrating with joy and peace long after the session ended.

Shiv Yatra gently yet powerfully reminds you to slow down, to listen inward, and to accept yourself exactly as you are.

I walked away lighter, clearer, and deeply grateful, not just for the practices, but for the people, the energy, and the sincerity that infused every moment.

This experience stays with you, quietly transforming the way you see yourself and the world. Truly a blessing and something I will always hold close to my heart.

Kudos to Shiv sir and Harsh sir alongside your beautiful family for organising this for us! 🙏

Thank you to all the fellow participants too for all the superb memories! And most importantly Nikita, if not for her I would never have known of this beautiful opportunity, heartfelt thanks all. ❤️❤️🙏🙏
